overall_goal: Loosen, flip, and cook the tortilla multiple times until done, then transfer it to a plate and serve

goals.description: Loosen the tortilla edges with a spatula
goals.rationale: The person uses a spatula to loosen the edges of the omelette to ensure it doesn't stick to the pan before flipping.

goals.description: Flip the tortilla using a lid and return it to the pan
goals.rationale: The person places a lid on the pan, flips the omelette onto it over the sink, and slides it back into the pan to cook the other side.

goals.description: Compact the tortilla edges and adjust the pan
goals.rationale: The person uses the spatula to press the edges of the omelette to maintain its shape while it cooks.

goals.description: Perform a second flip of the tortilla and return it to the pan
goals.rationale: The person flips the omelette again using the lid to ensure even cooking on both sides.

goals.description: Compress the tortilla edges again after the second flip
goals.rationale: The person uses the spatula to pat the edges of the omelette to keep it compact and well-shaped.

goals.description: Perform the final flip and transfer the tortilla to a plate
goals.rationale: The person flips the omelette one last time onto the lid and then slides it onto a serving plate.

goals.description: Serve the tortilla on the table and repair its shape
goals.rationale: The person brings the plated omelette to the table and uses a fork to fix any broken parts and reattach loose potato chunks.
